title: The All-Seeing Eye Clock
description: A massive blood-red eyeball with a vertical pupil and blue iris emerges from a gnarled dark tree that has grown through a shattered grandfather clock. A hooded purple-robed figure stands in the foreground reading a scroll labeled 'EYE OF TIME'.
prompt: A surreal dark fantasy scene featuring a giant bloody red eyeball with blue iris and slit pupil growing out of a twisted black tree that has burst through an ornate broken grandfather clock. The tree has gears and smaller red eyes on branches. A hooded wizard in flowing purple and teal robes stands reading an ancient scroll titled 'EYE OF TIME'. Scrolls hang from branches, potion bottles line shelves, bats fly in purple smoky sky, dark twisted trees in background, cinematic lighting, highly detailed digital painting.
